faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.description: Still have questions? Here are the answers to the most common ones.

whatIsLinkCard.question: What is LinkCard?
whatIsLinkCard.answer: LinkCard is a digital profile platform that lets you share your contact information, social media, portfolio, documents, and professional identity through one smart link and QR code.

physicalCard.question: Do I need a physical NFC card?
physicalCard.answer: No. Your LinkCard works perfectly with just a web link or QR code. NFC cards are optional and can be purchased separately.

updateInformation.question: Can I update my information after sharing my LinkCard?
updateInformation.answer: Yes. Edit your profile anytime. Everyone using your LinkCard will always see the latest version automatically.

freePlan.question: Is there a free plan?
freePlan.answer: Yes. You can create one LinkCard profile for free and upgrade whenever you need premium features.

companyProfiles.question: Can companies manage multiple employee profiles?
companyProfiles.answer: Yes. The Business plan allows organizations to manage employee profiles, apply company branding, and monitor analytics from one dashboard.

saveContact.question: Can people save my contact directly?
saveContact.answer: Yes. Visitors can save your contact information, call you, email you, or message you instantly from your LinkCard profile.
